meta.answer: I split it. First I build a small labelled set, maybe 100 questions with the gold passage marked, and measure recall@5 on retrieval alone. meta.answer: I split it. First I build a small labelled set, maybe 100 questions with the gold passage marked, and measure recall@5 on retrieval alone. On our policy-document assistant that came out at 0.62, so retrieval was clearly the problem. Then, for the cases where the gold passage was retrieved, I check whether the generated answer is actually grounded in it - I ran a support check with a second model call and about 9% of grounded-context answers still hallucinated. Fixing chunking, we went from 512 token fixed chunks to section-aware chunks with overlap, and recall@5 went to 0.88. Only after that did I touch the prompt.
